title: Z1DA--NRM CONST - 528A7-18-707 - Replace Boiler Stack Rome CBOC
agency: VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF > VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF > 242-NETWORK CONTRACT OFFICE 02 (36C242)
description:
CONTINUATION OF SF 30 BLOCK 14 AMENDMENT DESCRIPTION 0002 AGAINST SOLICITATION NO. 36C24227R0008

1. This amendment answers the following vendor questions:
Number of boiler vents:

On M-101 (Boiler and Generator Exhaust Plan, Phase II), the new wall penetration/chase is labeled with two 14" I.D. pipes and one 12" I.D. pipe. Keynote 2 calls for a single "new 14" boiler double walled insulated vent stack," and the cutover notes describe that one vent connecting to Boiler #1 and continuing to within two feet of Boiler #2's vent, so one common 14" vent appears to serve both boilers. The solicitation description, however, refers to "two new steel boiler exhaust stacks." Please confirm whether the work is: (a) one 14" double-wall vent common to Boiler #1 and Boiler #2, plus the 12" generator exhaust, or (b) two separate 14" double-wall vents (one per boiler), plus the 12" generator exhaust. If (a), please confirm what the second 14" pipe shown at the penetration represents.
Answer: Confirming: it is (b) two separate 14" double-wall vents (one per boiler), plus the 12" generator exhaust.
b) Draft control or stack fan:
No stack fan, draft inducer, or boiler-outlet draft control appears on the drawings. Section 23 51 00 (paragraph 2.2, Boiler Outlet Dampers and Accessories) refers to automatic draft control specified in Section 23 09 11, but Section 23 09 11 is not included in the solicitation. Please confirm whether: (a) the new boiler vent is intended to operate on natural draft (no fan or draft control required), or (b) a mechanical draft fan and/or barometric or motorized draft control is expected. If so, please issue Section 23 09 11 or identify the required equipment and control sequence.
Answer: Confirming: it is (a) the new boiler vent is intended to operate on natural draft (no fan or draft control required).
c) Design heating load and operating water temperatures:
Please provide the building design heating load (or recent gas and oil usage or meter data), and the normal heating-water supply and return temperatures for the two existing Fulton Vantage boilers. Return-water temperature sets the flue-gas temperature, which governs the vent sizing and draft calculation. Please also confirm whether the two boilers operate as lead/standby (N+1) or are both required at design load.
Answer: Replacing the boiler is not part of the contract. Boilers have inducer fans. There is no stack fan or boiler draft controls to be installed.
d) Facility designation:
Please confirm whether the Rome CBOC is designated mission-critical under VA Physical Security and Resiliency Design requirements, or otherwise required to keep heating on during a utility outage, as this affects the vent design for both fuels.
Answer: Rome CBOC is NOT designated as a Critical/Mission Critical facility. CBOCs are generally outpatient facilities rather than hospitals with inpatient, emergency, surgical, or continuity-of-government functions. Therefore, absent a specific VA risk assessment or designation, the Rome CBOC would not ordinarily be assumed to be mission critical.
e) Fuel oil and emergency power:
Boiler #2 fires #2 fuel oil as a backup fuel. Please confirm (a) whether the vent must be designed for oil firing on Boiler #2 (and on Boiler #1, if applicable), (b) the size and required reserve of the existing #2 oil tank, and (c) whether the boilers and their associated vent or draft equipment are served by emergency power through an automatic transfer switch.
Answer: The specified vent material (AL-29-4C) is compatible for operating the boilers on natural gas or #2 oil.  This contract does not include altering the existing fuel oil tank, day tank, the boilers, or the generator.  We are eliminating the existing exhaust stack and installing a new exhaust stack in a different location to serve the two existing boilers and existing emergency generator.

All other terms and conditions remain unchanged.
